The substantive requirements for affirmations under § 170.22 are as follows:

*   **Affirming Official:** A senior-level representative within the Organization Seeking Assessment (OSA) responsible for ensuring CMMC compliance and authorized to affirm continuing compliance with security requirements [L501].
*   **Affirmation Content:** Each affirmation must include the official's name, title, and contact information, as well as a statement attesting that the OSA has implemented and will maintain all applicable CMMC security requirements for information systems within the assessment scope [L503-L507].
*   **Submission Timing:** Affirmations are submitted in the following instances:
    *   Upon achievement of a Conditional CMMC Status [L511].
    *   Upon achievement of a Final CMMC Status [L513].
    *   Annually following a Final CMMC Status Date [L515].
    *   Following a POA&M closeout assessment [L517].
*   **SPRS:** All affirmations must be completed electronically in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) [L499, L519]. The Department verifies these submissions in SPRS to ensure contract compliance [L519].
*   **Level 1 Requirements:** Upon completion of a Level 1 self-assessment and annually thereafter, the Affirming Official must submit an affirmation attesting to continuing compliance with all requirements of CMMC Status Level 1 (Self) [L521].
